title: Fluffy Blueberry Pancakes
description: Light, fluffy pancakes packed with juicy blueberries.
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl.
Whisk eggs and milk, then combine with dry mix.
Fold in blueberries.
Cook on a hot griddle until golden on both sides.
Serve warm with syrup.
author: chef_maria

title: Vegan Chickpea Curry
description: A rich and creamy plant-based curry ready in under an hour.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic until soft.
Add curry powder and cook for a minute.
Stir in tomatoes and coconut milk.
Add chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve over rice.
author: green_kitchen

title: Classic Chocolate Brownies
description: Fudgy, rich brownies with a crackly top.
instructions: Melt butter and mix with sugar.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Fold in cocoa powder and flour.
Pour into a greased pan.
Bake at 350F for 30 minutes.
author: sweet_tooth

title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
description: A protein-packed classic salad with a tangy dressing.
instructions: Grill chicken until fully cooked.
Chop lettuce and place in a bowl.
Slice chicken and add to the bowl.
Top with parmesan and croutons.
Drizzle with Caesar dressing and toss.
author: healthy_eats

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: A comforting Italian classic, slow-cooked to creamy perfection.
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms until golden.
Add rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Pour in wine and let it absorb.
Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring often.
Finish with parmesan and serve.
author: chef_maria

title: Vegan Banana Oat Muffins
description: Naturally sweetened muffins, perfect for a quick breakfast.
instructions: Mash bananas in a large bowl.
Stir in maple syrup and almond milk.
Fold in oats and baking soda.
Spoon into muffin cups.
Bake at 375F for 18-20 minutes.
author: green_kitchen
